description:
Collect inventory data and metrics of your hosts and sends it to the New Relic platform.


What's Changed
🛡️ Security notices
- Bump dependency newrelic/nrjmx to v2.14.0 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2336 to address CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428
- Bump dependency newrelic/nri-prometheus to v2.30.4 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2335
- Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.83.1 to 1.83.2 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2342 to address CVE-2026-84445
- Bump containerd to v1.7.35 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2340 to address CVE-2026-53495
- Bump dependency newrelic/nri-flex to v1.18.13 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2343 to address CVE-2026-56855 and CVE-2026-78662
🐞 Bug fixes
- replace deprecated MemoryLimit with MemoryMax for systemd >=231 in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2337
- add groupfs check for tmp file ownership in https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/pull/2345
Full Changelog: https://github.com/newrelic/infrastructure-agent/compare/1.80.3...1.80.4
